title: Reverse Integer
description:
Given a signed 32-bit integer x, return x with its digits reversed. If reversing x causes the value to go outside the signed 32-bit integer range [-231, 231 - 1], then return 0. Assume the environment does not allow you to store 64-bit integers (signed or unsigned).

## Examples

```text
Example 1
Input: x = 123
Output: 321
```

```text
Example 2
Input: x = -123
Output: -321
```

```text
Example 3
Input: x = 120
Output: 21
```

## Constraints

- -2^31 <= x <= 2^31 - 1

Reverse the decimal digits of x while preserving its sign. Return 0 if the reversed value falls outside the signed 32-bit integer range.
